## v0.5.5 · Remote RPC Routing and Light Media

v0.5.5 fixes authenticated remote WebUI calls that could receive HTTP 403, and refreshes the memory-space documentation with Light screenshots and recordings.

### Changes

- Route remote status, Source catalog, settings, View, activation and management calls through DSH's namespaced API Gateway; preserve local loopback channels and handle remote-desktop Host-ownership flags.
- Preserve DSH authentication and pairing. Gateway writes, ZIP operations, View mutations and settings mutations require `remoteAccess: trusted-host`; without it, readable settings report `writable: false`. Existing write restrictions remain active.
- Refresh the packaged bilingual READMEs and current guides with 60 Light JPEGs and two continuous demos, captured after importing a Mnemon Pack into disposable storage. Preserve original v0.5.4 capture labels and all historical media hashes.
- Update deployment guidance to distinguish browser authentication from Mnemon's explicit remote-management grant.

Implementation: [#197](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/197), [#196](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/196).

### Packages and upgrade

Only `dsh-mnemon` advances to **0.5.5**. All sixteen official plugins remain pinned at **0.5.4** and are not republished.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.5
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser. Use `headless` for that Profile. Mnemon CLI remains independently maintained through `@mnemon-dev/mnemon` on npm.

No memory-data migration is required. Rollback uses `dsh-mnemon@0.5.4` in the same Profile. The release workflow verifies the frozen Starter, the full mixed-version npm composition and a real Registry upgrade from v0.4.7 before creating this release.

### 中文说明

本版修复远程页面已认证但状态、目录或设置请求仍返回 HTTP 403 的问题，改用 DSH API Gateway，同时保留本地回环通道。远程管理仍需显式 `remoteAccess: trusted-host` 授权，未授权的设置快照保持只读。

中英文文档采用导入备份后采集的 60 张浅色截图和两段连续演示，真实保留 v0.5.4 采集版本与历史媒体来源。本次仅发布主包 0.5.5，十六个子包保持 0.5.4；重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器即可使用新路由，无需迁移记忆数据。

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.5/docs/en/releases/v0.5.5.md), [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.5/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.5.md), and [Light media gallery](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.5/docs/assets/webui-v0.5.4/README.md) for compatibility, provenance and validation limits.
